svg.text: NVIDIA FP8/FP4 Transformer acceleration library - github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine - PyTorch + JAX + shared C++ core
L1 - Framework Integration + Workloads (LLM pretrain/finetune/inference - MoE - multimodal - FP8 on Hopper/Blackwell)
L2 - Three-Tier Model (Python modules - C++ extensions - libtransformer_engine.so shared core)
FFI bridge to same C++ kernels as PyTorch
L3 - Python Module Surface (Transformer building blocks - fused layers - distributed helpers)
LayerNormMLP - fused norm + FC1 + act + FC2
FP8 weight init via fp8_model_init context
DotProductAttention - Q K V fused SDPA path
varlen cu_seqlens - paged KV - alibi - window
Backend dispatch: FlashAttn2/3 cuDNN TE native
TransformerLayer = attn block + FFN MLP block
fp8_autocast / autocast - enable FP8 forward region
backward() must run outside fp8_autocast region
Format E4M3 E5M2 HYBRID - margin amax history
L4 - FP8 Execution Pipeline (recipe - quantize - GEMM/attn - dequantize - amax sync on autocast exit)
Module forward casts BF16/FP16 to FP8 E4M3/E5M2
Per-tensor scale from amax history metadata
NVTETensor carries scale_inv amax dptr shape
cuBLASLt FP8 GEMM on 4th-gen Tensor Cores
Exit autocast - aggregate amax - NCCL sync
L5 - Kernel Backends (common/ CUDA kernels - NVIDIA library dispatch - attention multi-backend)
FA3 prioritized over FA2 on Blackwell
Specialized GEMM and norm fusion tiles
L6 - Source Package Layout (transformer_engine/ - common/ - pytorch/ - jax/ - CMake + pybind build)
FP8 GEMM Execution Path (te.Linear forward under fp8_autocast)
DelayedScaling recipe - per-tensor amax history - cuBLASLt FP8 Tensor Core dispatch
Step 1: with te.autocast(enabled=True, recipe=DelayedScaling(...)): enter FP8 region
Step 2: te.Linear forward - cast input/weight BF16 to FP8 E4M3 with per-tensor scale
Step 3: _Linear autograd fn calls pybind gemm() - wrap at::Tensor as NVTETensor
Step 4: nvte_cublas_gemm_v2 - pass FP8 dptr + scale_inv metadata to cuBLASLt
Step 5: Exit autocast - aggregate amax tensors - NCCL sync scales - loss.backward() outside
Both dims must be divisible by 16 for FP8 Linear - pad seqlen to multiple of 16 if needed
Attention path: DotProductAttention dispatches FlashAttn2/3 or cuDNN fused attn by arch + seqlen
Blackwell: MXFP8BlockScaling and NVFP4BlockScaling recipes for microscaling and 4-bit training
NVIDIA Transformer FP8 layer - sits between LLM frameworks and cuBLASLt/cuDNN hardware libs
Design Position (NVIDIA Transformer FP8 layer - recipe-managed scaling + fused modules on Tensor Cores)
Shared libtransformer_engine.so + fp8_autocast + TransformerLayer = default FP8 path for Megatron/NeMo LLM training
Init: pip install transformer_engine[pytorch] - CUDA 12.1+ cuDNN 9.3+ - FP8 needs CC 8.9+ Ada/Hopper/Blackwell
Loop: autocast region forward - amax aggregate on exit - backward outside - optional CUDA Graph + Userbuffers TP
